title: vicia unguiculata subsp. atropurpurea
intro: Vicia unguiculata subsp. atropurpurea, commonly known as purple vetch or black vetch, is a subspecies of the vetch plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of purple vetch include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, making it a potential remedy for various conditions. The bioactive constituents present in purple vetch include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
